supporting_observations.claim: At 14:09 UTC, greta.lund launched Remote Desktop to DC-MAP-01, and the workstation logged a TCP connection to that host on port 3389.
The Remote Desktop session to DC-MAP-01 was logged on the domain controller as a type 10 logon from WS-GLUND-01 using greta.lund's account.

known_telemetry_limitations: Both WinSec and Sysmon collection on DC-MAP-01 were unavailable from 13:20 through 14:15 UTC, including the alerted account-creation time.
The supplied records contain no direct account-creation event, account attributes, or group-membership change for temp.rwong.
claims_not_established: Who created temp.rwong and whether the account was created at the reported time.
Whether temp.rwong was added only to Externals or received administrator or other privileges.
Whether greta.lund's 14:09 Remote Desktop session to DC-MAP-01 was related to the account creation.
Whether the account creation was authorized or malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain alternative domain-controller audit records for the alert window, especially account creation and group-membership events.
Check directory state and audit history for temp.rwong, including its creation time, creator, enabled status, and group memberships.
Correlate DC-MAP-01 authentication and session records with greta.lund's Remote Desktop session and the reported account-creation event.
unrelated_findings: WS-GLUND-01 accessed drive.google.com through the proxy; Google Drive is not an approved service in the supplied environment context. This does not establish a connection to the account alert. (T158-00002)

greta.lund launched a dotnet SDK installer from the user Temp directory. Its purpose and provenance are not established, and it does not establish a connection to the account alert. (T158-00009, T158-00010)
